cmd-directory-desc: Opens the global directory of known traders
gui-trade-cart-limit: The cart supports up to {0} item types.
gui-trade-sell-empty: Place items in the {0} slots above to see their valuation.
tooltip-sell-untradeable: Valuation: No value at this post.
tooltip-sell-overstocked: Valuation: Overstocked due to recent saturation.
tooltip-buy-stock:
Available stock: {0}
Left-click: +1 to cart | Right-click: -1
tooltip-buy-out-of-stock: OUT OF STOCK (wait for next rotation)
gui-dir-filter-empty: No known traders match the selected type.
gui-dir-empty-title: You haven't visited any traders in this world yet.
gui-dir-empty-subtitle: Talk to a trader in the world to register their offers and demands here.
msg-too-far: You must move closer to the trader.
msg-empty-trade: No complete lots to sell and no items in the cart.
msg-trader-not-enough-gears: The trader does not have enough gears ({0} gears).
config-economy-mode-comment: Stingy (sell +25%, pay -25%); Balanced (100%); Businessmen (sell 100%, pay +20% on sales only)
config-directory-sync-mode-comment: LastVisitedSnapshot = last state seen when visiting; LiveKnownTraders = live rotation updates
config-enable-instant-trade-comment: Allows trading remotely with known traders directly from the global directory
config-show-valuation-tooltip-comment: Shows the estimated base value in the tooltip when hovering in your regular inventory
config-enable-debug-logging-comment: Prints valuation, saturation, and rotation calculations to game chat and logs
config-saturation-scope-comment: LocalOnly = that trader only; NearbyPartial = partially spreads to nearby traders; Global = worldwide
config-saturation-spillover-radius-comme: Maximum distance at which saturation partially spreads between traders
config-saturation-spillover-factor-comme: Maximum saturation fraction propagated to neighboring traders (0.35 = 35%)
config-saturation-s50-comment: Equivalent base gears sold after which payout drops to half
config-saturation-curve-power-comment: Controls how fast payout drops as an item becomes saturated
config-saturation-min-floor-comment: Minimum multiplier a saturated item can drop to (0.20 = 20%)
config-saturation-recovery-per-day-comme: Amount of saturation cleared per elapsed in-game day
config-daily-demand-min-pct-comment: Minimum extra reward percentage per trader on wanted items (20%)
config-daily-demand-max-pct-comment: Maximum extra reward percentage per trader on wanted items (50%)
config-min-durability-ratio-comment: Minimum durability fraction to accept tools or armor (0.80 = 80%)
config-anti-arbitrage-cap-factor-comment: Maximum fraction of own selling price a trader will pay to buy back that item
config-max-physical-trade-distance-comme: Maximum allowed distance to the trader to perform a trade
